vulnerability.explanation: After computing len = strlen(base) and only checking (len > 499) || (len < 5), the code does len -= 4 to strip ".xsd" and then reads base[len - 2] without ensuring len >= 2. For a minimal valid base length of 5 (e.g., "a.xsd"), len becomes 1 and base[len - 2] accesses base[-1], reading before the start of the string.
